objective: Provide provenance-preserving strain and temperature inputs for a later EDT analysis of connected XY8 operating regions.

scope.material: negatively charged nitrogen-vacancy centre in diamond
excluded: fitting any parameter to the existing EDT optimum
using validation data to tune an input law

analysis_freeze_policy.replacement_rule: A replacement requires a new bundle version, new file digests, and retention of this frozen version.

sources.citation: P. Udvarhelyi et al., Spin-strain interaction in nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond, Physical Review B 98, 075201 (2018).
sources.quantity: six DFT spin-strain and spin-stress coefficients
sources.extraction_method: direct transcription of tabulated central values and reported one-sigma uncertainties

sources.citation: H. Tang et al., First-Principles Calculation of the Temperature-Dependent Transition Energies in Spin Defects, Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters 14 (2023).

M. C. Cambria et al., Physically motivated analytical expression for the temperature dependence of the zero-field splitting of the nitrogen-vacancy center in diamond, Physical Review B 108, L180102 (2023).
sources.extraction_method: direct transcription of equation, central values, and one-sigma uncertainties

sources.citation: S. Mondal and A. Lunghi, Spin-phonon decoherence in solid-state paramagnetic defects from first principles, npj Computational Materials 9, 120 (2023).
sources.quantity: ab initio NV T1 relaxation rate versus temperature
sources.source_location: Figure 3 left panel; arXiv source asset tau_NV.pdf
sources.extraction_method: vector PDF centerline extraction; logarithmic T and rate axes calibrated to published ticks

digitization_uncertainty.scope: coordinate extraction only; does not represent first-principles model uncertainty

sources.digitization_rationale: The paper gives the functional form but does not report the complete numerical amplitude coefficients needed to reproduce the black ab initio curve.

sources.citation: A. Jarmola et al., Temperature- and Magnetic-Field-Dependent Longitudinal Spin Relaxation in Nitrogen-Vacancy Ensembles in Diamond, Physical Review Letters 108, 197601 (2012).
sources.extraction_method: direct transcription; main-text A2 value takes precedence over inconsistent supplementary rendering

sources.citation: V. M. Acosta et al., Erratum: Temperature Dependence of the Nitrogen-Vacancy Magnetic Resonance in Diamond, Physical Review Letters 106, 209901 (2011).
sources.extraction_method: direct transcription of corrected central value and one-sigma uncertainty

next_stage: Generate temperature- and strain-conditioned XY8 score surfaces only after the digest file has been written and verified.
